Let me build ki-validierung and then finalize.

action.command:
cat > /tmp/build_kiv.sh <<'SH'
#!/bin/bash
set -e
CTX=/tmp/g_ki-validierung
rm -rf "$CTX"; mkdir -p "$CTX"
cp -r /workspace/03-shared-services/ki-validierung/. "$CTX"/
rm -rf "$CTX/.git"
cp -r /workspace/03-shared-services/prompt-loader "$CTX/prompt-loader"
sed -i 's|path = "\.\./prompt-loader"|path = "prompt-loader"|g' "$CTX/pyproject.toml"
awk '{print} /^WORKDIR \/app[[:space:]]*$/ {print "COPY prompt-loader/ ./prompt-loader/"}' "$CTX/Dockerfile" > "$CTX/Dockerfile.n" && mv "$CTX/Dockerfile.n" "$CTX/Dockerfile"
cd "$CTX"
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
rm -f uv.lock
uv lock >/tmp/lock_kiv.log 2>&1 || { echo LOCKFAIL; tail -8 /tmp/lock_kiv.log; exit 3; }
export DUMMY_USER=x DUMMY_TOKEN=x
DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 timeout 590 docker build --secret id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=DUMMY_USER --secret id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=DUMMY_TOKEN -t ki-validierung .
SH
chmod +x /tmp/build_kiv.sh
/tmp/build_kiv.sh > /tmp/build_kiv2.log 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"; tail -6 /tmp/build_kiv2.log
